summary: Soldat entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Soldat
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows/Steam build, with server and client version recorded

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows client and server state

primary.version: Current Soldat Classic / Steam or official PC build
primary.why: Soldat is a 2D multiplayer shooter with an official PC route and later open-source/community continuity. The Windows build is the practical route, but archive captures must record server/client version because public multiplayer state changes over time.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Windows/Steam build. Record client version, server, game mode, bots vs online players, map, mods, registered/free state if relevant, network conditions, and whether source-code/community builds were used.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting long-term preservation or custom server behavior.
secondary.why: It may differ from the official distributed build and should be labeled.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether using official binaries, source/community builds, mods, or custom servers.
